headline: Proved Web Analytics works end to end (reverting two fixes built on wrong premises; the zero was real traffic), disclosed it on /privacy/, and closed a release-proof strand hidden by a missing graph edge.

items.title: Analytics verified end to end in a real browser
items.insight: One nonce-bound beacon per page, no CSP violations, report POST to same-origin /cdn-cgi/rum answered 204, and four headless test visits were ingested within minutes (bot=1). The seven-day zero was real. A Worker injection and a connect-src change built on wrong premises were reverted unshipped; the injection would have double-counted.
items.evidence: Chromium network log (beacon 200, /cdn-cgi/rum 204, 0 securitypolicyviolation); GraphQL site tag 5ed6e30f: 4 ChromeHeadless rows after the test, none in the prior 7 days

items.title: Privacy page discloses Cloudflare Web Analytics
items.insight: The beacon had run on every page since March without mention; the page now says what it collects and how to block it.
items.evidence: privacy/index.html; AI disclosure, footer and sitemap checks pass

items.title: A release-proof strand hidden by a missing graph edge
items.insight: build-release-proof reads api/release-dependencies.json but the graph did not say so. Modeled, the cascade gate named Weekly Maintenance, which now rebuilds and stages the proof.
items.evidence: cascade gate negative control then 29/29 closed; coverage 73/92 baseline 19

items.title: An empty secret scan is not a clean one
items.insight: The scanner printed Clean over zero staged files. It now says nothing was scanned and can fail on emptiness with --require-files.
items.evidence: scan-secrets: nothing staged exit 0 message, --require-files exit 3, 1 file Clean

items.title: Route guard and transient-lock retry
items.insight: capture-theme-matrix refuses Git Bash-mangled routes before 84 blank captures; build-og-cards retries transient Windows locks that failed a full build.
items.evidence: theme matrix exit 2 on mangled route; writeFileWithRetry 3 behaviour checks; og-cards self-test 21/21

followUps: Watch human (bot=0) page loads now that the pipeline is proven.
